Class MoleculeStructure

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.molecule.MoleculeStructure
public final class MoleculeStructure extends Object
Represents a complete molecular structure consisting of atoms, chemical bonds, 3D coordinates, and spatial bounds.

    • stereochemistry

      public Map<Integer, StereoConfiguration> stereochemistry()
      Returns immutable, load-time CIP assignments keyed by index in atoms(). Unspecified centers and explicit-coordinate structures have no entries. A visible tetrahedral arrangement alone does not establish an authored configuration.
      Returns:
      supplied, validated R/S assignments

    • withPositions

      public MoleculeStructure withPositions(List<org.joml.Vector3f> positions)
      Repositions the same graph while preserving annotations and absolute configurations. A specified tetrahedron may not become flat or change handedness. This supports rigid bond/torsion constraints without recomputing priorities or chemistry in a viewer.
      Parameters:
      positions - exactly one finite position per existing atom
      Returns:
      immutable repositioned structure
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if atom counts differ or a specified center is inverted/flattened
